content: {"like":["Enjoys sharp, detailed costume and art direction in period dramas and fantasy films","Values strong chemistry between lead actors in romantic or action‑drama settings","Prefers fast‑paced, twist‑heavy narratives in sci‑fi and action movies","Appreciates visually striking, high‑production‑value set designs in space epics","Likes homage to classic filmmakers in indie or art‑house projects"],"dislike":["Detests excessive vulgarity and low‑brow humor in comedy‑westerns","Criticizes weak, recycled scripts and lack of originality in sci‑fi sequels","Dislikes over‑polished, pristine costumes that feel inauthentic in period pieces","Finds choppy editing and pacing issues in action‑drama and fantasy films","Rejects poorly executed makeup, hair, and continuity errors in blockbuster movies"]}
